utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: What time does the repair drive start, and where should I bring things?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: It starts at 9, and bring things to the community center entrance by the side parking lot.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Got it, thanks. I’ll bring my things to the community center entrance by the side parking lot at 9.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing, Noah. I can bring over a few tools and help however I can with the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right, the repair drive. Thanks, Gus - I probably would've spaced on that.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: No problem, I’ll swing by with the tools and we can get it sorted.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, the repair drive’s the talk of the block right now - folks have been dropping off supplies all morning.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I hope someone checked whether they’ve got enough van space for everything.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Yeah, I heard they’re sending a second van over by noon if the donations keep coming like this.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I can help with that, Opal. Just point me to what's broken.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: It’s the faucet in the kitchen, under the left sink. The pipe’s leaking pretty badly.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I’ll take a look at it right away. If you’ve got a towel or bucket nearby, set it under the leak while I check the shutoff.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Oh, the repair drive is coming up fast, and I’m telling everyone I can. You should come by and bring anyone else who might help.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Definitely come by, Uli, and bring anyone who’s willing to lend a hand. The more people, the faster we get it done.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely, Leo. I’ll organize the repair drive and keep you posted on what we still need.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Thanks, Rosa. I’ll be ready to help with the drive.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Perfect, Leo. I’ll send you the list of what we still need, and we can start as soon as you’re ready.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Can you remind me what needs fixing for the repair drive? I want to make sure I have the details right.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Mostly the leaky sink in the kitchen and the front gate that sticks. I can help list the rest if you need it.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, that helps. Is there anything else on the list, or just those two for now?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can help with that after school pickup if you can swing it. What part of the repair drive still needs coverage?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: The main thing still needing coverage is the heavy lifting for the south-side wall and the cleanup bins. I can take the cleanup if you can grab the wall crew.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can take the wall crew after pickup. Do you need me to bring anything specific for the south-side wall?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I heard there’s a repair drive going on, but I only caught that secondhand. Is Jules the person I should ask for the details?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Yes, I can help with that. I’m Jules, and I’ve got the repair drive details if you want them.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Yes, please tell me the details.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: So the repair drive is actually happening today, right?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yeah, it’s today. I think folks start in a bit.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can help if you need a hand with the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Rey. I might need a little help figuring out where I left the tools, though.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Sure, let’s look around together. If you tell me where you last had them, I can help retrace your steps.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I can help with the repair drive, Cleo. I’ll keep mentioning it to folks so we get the word around.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Vik. I’ll keep an eye on supplies and make sure folks know where to bring what they can spare.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: That sounds good, Cleo. I’ll keep telling folks about the repair drive and point them your way for supplies.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I heard they’re getting the repair drive together. If you need a hand, I can swing by after errands.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, I might take you up on that.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Glad to hear it. I’ll let you know when I’m back from errands, and we can head over together.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right, the repair drive. I meant to bring that by earlier, but I forgot—what do you still need from me?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Mostly the hardware stuff for the shelving and that loose hinge by the side gate. I can make a quick list if you want, and then we can split it up.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Yeah, make the list and I’ll grab whatever I can from the hardware store. I’m sorry I blanked on it again.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Yeah, I think I heard about that. What’s the repair drive for again?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: It’s for fixing small stuff around the neighborhood, like appliances, bikes, and other broken items.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right — small fixes people can bring in? That makes sense.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Absolutely, Eli. I’ve got a few tools I can lend out for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That sounds fine, Gus. Just keep the loaned tools organized, and I’ll stop by at the usual time.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Will do, Eli. I’ll keep everything organized and be ready when you stop by.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I can help with that repair drive, Quinn. Tell me what still needs doing and I’ll see what I can take on.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I can help round up a few hands for the repair drive if you need it.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: That would help a lot, Jules. I’m trying to pin down the houses on Maple and the community hall first.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Great, I can help with that. I’ll check in with folks on Maple and see who can meet at the hall.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Cleo, I’ve got the repair drive list updated and I’m ready to coordinate the next round of pickups.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Great, I’ll grab what I can and keep the list straight.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Perfect, I’ll keep the list straight and coordinate the pickups from there.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: When does the repair drive start?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I heard it starts later today, but I don't know the exact time yet.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sure, I can help with that. What's the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: It’s a fundraiser to help pay for home repairs for families in the neighborhood. I can send you the details if you’re interested.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Yes, please send me the details.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Of course, I can help with that.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just to confirm, you mean you can help with the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Yes, that’s right. I can help with the repair drive.
